title: Isolation of primary cells from surgically harvested tissues for the establishment of human tissue cultures
summary: This study is a single-center, prospective research project. Tissue donations are anonymized. The harvested tissue is processed in the research facilities of the Department of Cardiothoracic Surgery at the University Hospital or, following harvest, shipped to the research laboratory of the scientific partner in accordance with regulatory requirements [9, 10].
